info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Logistics Shipments Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Status API provides businesses with real-time visibility into the status of their logistics shipments. Through this API, clients can efficiently query the current status of various shipments, enabling better tracking and management of logistics operations. This endpoint is particularly useful for logistics managers, supply chain coordinators, and customer service teams, who require timely updates to ensure operational efficiency. The API enhances decision-making and customer satisfaction by streamlining access to shipment information.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of shipments.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the latest status of shipments in the system. It provides real-time updates regarding the shipping status, including any delays or issues that may have arisen during transit.

requestBody.description: This request body is designed to provide the necessary information to query the status of shipments. It must conform to the specified schema to ensure proper processing of the request.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.
